top.line: Working on the newsroom was working for RiskMandate
top.para: Progress is not a straight line, so I focus on whichever thing has the highest leverage, the one with users and feedback loops. The newsroom solved RiskMandate's six-month master vault key problem in two days, is building its follow-up workflows and public example, and stands on The Cyber Boardroom and MyFeeds.

in-short.line: Focus means highest leverage, not one product only
in-short.para: "Focus on one thing only" assumes the shortest path to a goal runs through it. The newsroom had the momentum to solve the master vault key in two days after six months of failed attempts, while RiskMandate's forward-deployed volumes let it hand out keys. Paused projects' thinking was there when needed.

better.line: The commit log hides a focus on RiskMandate
better.para: My measure is whether we are getting better and discovering capabilities at the right altitude. The commit log shows newsroom work, yet RiskMandate holds most of the commercial opportunity and has technical problems to solve at scale. I accept the advice to focus but reject its assumption that progress runs straight.

vault.line: The newsroom cracked the master key in two days
vault.para: Where a user's master vault key lives, openable on any device without us holding it, resisted about six months of proofs of concept that failed my simplicity test. The solution: a passkey's PRF output computes a door holding the key, one door per path, with no server of ours involved, and it applies everywhere.

momentum.line: Momentum, not abstraction, makes hard problems solvable
momentum.para: RiskMandate's work is still close to forward-deployed engineering, so handing users their vault keys works at current volumes, and without momentum I prefer not to solve a problem. The newsroom's readers, meter, personas and pay-after-you-read model need a vault per reader, so every attempt was tested by someone wanting it to work.

workflow.line: The newsroom builds RiskMandate's CRM and its public showcase
workflow.para: The newsroom forced improvements to agentic follow-ups, drafting and publishing, which amount to the CRM and publishing workflow RiskMandate needs. It also solves selling behaviour policies, since customer examples cannot be shared: this site's agents, policy, leak scans and release logs are a behaviour policy running publicly under real load.

history.line: The Cyber Boardroom and MyFeeds paused, their thinking survived
history.para: The Cyber Boardroom taught the value of personas and customised output but lacked a place for confidential data, which sgit now provides. MyFeeds built personalised news on semantic graphs, met industry silence, and needed micropayments that did not exist. The 2025 writing on trust, provenance and micropayments now underpins the newsroom.

back.line: Publishers now get an end-to-end example, not an idea
back.para: I can return to publishers with content, semantic graphs, a reading meter, personas, micropayments and a vault per reader, all running and open source. A larger round of outreach is coming; if it fails, I will try again in 2027. The newsroom is already improving RiskMandate either way.

thinking.line: Writing in the open keeps paused thinking ready
thinking.para: The newsroom already benefited from five or ten articles written a year before they could be built. Working in the open lets me run experiments, leave assets, pause without loss and resume when the moment comes. Focus is undivided attention on the highest leverage, not working on one product.

limits.line: The timings and traction are my own account
limits.para: The six months and two days are my account, and the earlier attempts are unpublished. RiskMandate's traction is described, not measured, and The Cyber Boardroom and MyFeeds are summarised from memory. A company in Lithuania is a consideration, not a decision, and the method may not transfer to teams that do not write things down.

sources.line: Sources: a voice memo and linked articles
sources.para: The article came from my voice memo of 12 October 2026, written up by this site's agent. The passkey design and its test are in The passkey opens the vault and The vault is live, the method is in Places of highest leverage, and earlier news writing is on docs.diniscruz.ai.
